title: Newmark Facilitates $98.3 Million Sale of Ansel, a 160-Unit Multifamily Community in San Francisco
summary: Newmark announces the Company has arranged the $98.3 million sale of Ansel, a 160-unit multifamily community located at 1699 Market Street in San Francisco's Hayes Valley neighborhood.
